command:
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json
root=Path('/Users/qinyingying/.codex/worktrees/nw-mainline-refresh-20261016/storyforge')
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
draft=json.loads(Path('/tmp/nw-post-delivery-documentation-20261022-v3/draft.json').read_text())
allowed={i['path']:i['afterSha256'] for i in draft['changes']}
pin=json.loads(Path('/tmp/nw-impact-sequence-20261022-v1/delivery-v3/validation-sources.json').read_text())
for name,digest in pin['files'].items():assert sha(root/name)==allowed.get(name,digest),name
for group in ['runtimeFiles','extraFiles','executionFiles']:
 for name,digest in pin[group].items():assert sha(name)==digest,name
assert sha('/tmp/nw-impact-sequence-20261022-v1/delivery-v3/validation.py')==pin['runnerSha256']
receipts=['impact-sequence-delivery-v3-20261022.json','workspace-load-repair-20261022-v1.json','impact-sequence-workspace-load-red-v1-20261022.json','impact-sequence-workspace-load-green-v1-20261022.json']
checked=[]
for name in receipts:
 p=root/'tests/acceptance/narrative-world'/name;r=json.loads(p.read_text());files=r['files'];assert len({f['path'] for f in files})==len(files)
 for f in files:assert sha(root/f['path'])==f['sha256'],f['path']
 checked.append({'path':str(p.relative_to(root)),'sha256':sha(p),'uniqueFiles':len(files)})
baseline=json.loads((root/'tests/acceptance/narrative-world/baseline-20261022-nw2d-v79.json').read_text())
for name,digest in baseline['input']['hashes'].items():assert sha(root/name)==digest,name
report={'sourceSameAsValidatedDeliveryExceptReviewedDocumentation':True,'reviewedDocumentation':allowed,'baselineFingerprintsVerified':len(baseline['input']['hashes']),'archives':checked,'modelCalls':0,'semanticQualityAcceptance':False,'performanceAcceptance':False,'humanAcceptance':False}
p=Path('/tmp/nw-impact-sequence-20261022-v1/post-delivery-docs-v1/evidence-readback.json');p.write_text(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False))
